feedback: Checkout flow is seamless, paid in under 30 seconds!
The returns process is an absolute nightmare. Waited 3 weeks for a refund.
Search results are totally irrelevant. Searched 'blue sneakers' and got sandals 😤
Order arrived 2 days early! Very impressed with the delivery speed.
Cannot login with Google — just spins forever then crashes the app
Product photos are misleading. Item looks nothing like the picture.
My order was marked as delivered but I never received it. Tracking info stopped updating.
Wish list feature disappeared after the last update. Please bring it back!
The new product recommendation engine is spot on. Found exactly what I needed.
Payment keeps failing with no error message. Had to use a different card 4 times.
Customer support was rude and dismissive when I reported my issue.
Size guide is inaccurate — ordered my usual size and it was way too small.
Promo code SAVE20 is not working at checkout. Error says 'invalid code' but it's listed on your site.
App crashes every time I try to view my order history.
Great selection of products. Love how easy it is to filter by brand.
The 'Sort by Price' function is broken. Items show in random order.
Duplicate charge on my account. Was billed twice for the same order!
Notification for order dispatch never came. Found out by checking manually.
Absolutely love the eco-friendly packaging. A great initiative 🌱
Out-of-stock items should not appear in search results. Very frustrating.
Return label printed but the courier won't accept it. QR code is unreadable.
The dark mode on the app is gorgeous. Finally a shopping app that doesn't blind me at night.
Delivery partner left the package outside in the rain. Everything was damaged.
App is super slow on my older Android phone. Takes 10+ seconds to load product pages.
Discount was not applied even though I met the minimum order value. Had to contact support.
The saved addresses keep disappearing. I have to re-enter my address every time.
Ordered 2 items, only 1 arrived. The packing slip says both were included.
The product review system is great — detailed, helpful, and well-organized.
Can't filter reviews by star rating. I want to see the critical ones first.
Buy Now button is unresponsive on iPad. Have to reload the page to make it work.
Live chat connected me to an agent in 30 seconds. Issue resolved immediately. 10/10
The seller took 3 weeks to ship but tracking showed it as 'processing' the whole time.
App crashes when I open a product with more than 20 images.
Gift wrapping option is a really thoughtful addition. Used it for my mom's birthday.
My account was suspended without warning or explanation. What's going on?
The comparison feature side-by-side is fantastic for choosing between products.
Received a completely wrong item. The box was correct but contents were not.
Fingerprint login stopped working after the last update. Now I have to type my password every time.
The price tracker feature is amazing — got alerted when my wishlist item dropped 40%.
Cannot apply two coupons at once. The second one just disappears.
Product descriptions are often copy-pasted from manufacturer with no actual information about fit.
Flash sale items sold out before the sale even started. How??
The app's AR 'try-on' feature for glasses is incredible. Saved me a trip to the store.
Why does my cart empty itself every time I close the app?
Subscription box arrived missing 3 items. Have been waiting a week for a response.
The homepage loads too many animations and it makes everything lag.
Refund was processed to a card I no longer have. Need this escalated urgently!
This app has become my go-to for shopping. Reliable, fast, and great deals 😊
Seller ratings are nowhere near the product listing. Why hide that?
My last 3 orders have all had at least one wrong item. Quality control is non-existent.
